variants.before:
Ahh yes, the professor expanding the mind of his students. My name is Elinos. Pleased to meet you.
I am a Spiritmaster. I have been trained to bind a person's soul to a certain location if they so wish it.
When a person is slain, their spirit will return to where they are bound. There, his body and possessions will rematerialize.
Only when the gods deem that your destiny has been fulfilled will you truly die. Until then you will always return.
After I bind you, I shall send you to Thirtreel, our coachman. You will find him next to a well on the southern road.

There are stables all across Tunaria. Not all are friendly though, so watch your step when looking for a stable.
Ok, your name is recorded. You should head back to your professor now. And remember me when you need a horse!

variants.before:
Good day, good citizen.

In addition to recording and retelling epic tales of adventure you will often find yourself to be the hero of such tales.
Such will be the case if you can accomplish this next task. Bandits have been raiding caravans into the city as of late.
Their theft of imported goods include food and supplies for the poor, a lot which cannot withstand any more bad breaks.
If you truly wish to earn a place in our halls, you must put a stop to these highwaymen and recover the stolen goods.
Will you aid our city's most disheartened citizen by embarking on this task?
